messages:
anna_sales: Quick heads-up — SilverPine (POC) asked for our SOC 2 artifacts, a signed pen-test confirmation letter, and temporary SSO test accounts so they can validate integration before procurement. ETA requested for next Tue.

raj_solutions: We can produce the SOC2 summary + control mapping spreadsheet. Which level of detail do they need? full evidence or summary? Also they want a sample network diagram for Private deployment.

mike_infosec: We don't hand over raw evidence. We can share the SOC 2 report summary, control mappings, and a redacted pen-test attestation letter that says a 3rd-party pentest was completed — infosec sign-off required. I'll draft the letter and route to legal. :lock: 

jess_platform: For SSO we can create two staging SAML accounts (one admin, one read-only) and a short-lived client in the staging tenant. Would that satisfy their test plan? Note: we should exclude production logs and PII from the staging dump.

anna_sales: Yes they explicitly want to run end-to-end SSO + a sample inference request against the Dedicated preview pool. They also had pricing Q: if they convert to Dedicated after POC, what's the earliest start date and can we provide a short-term discount for the pilot?

raj_solutions: On the Dedicated side, explain reserved capacity commitments and the pilot discount policy — usually one-month trial on a small reserved pool, then conversion to 6/12m. I'll add numbers once finance confirms. Can someone confirm egress/replication costs for EU regions?

mike_infosec: Agree on redacted artifacts only. I'll attach the draft pen-test attestation by EOD. Legal_bot: please confirm acceptable NDA language for sharing control matrices.

legal_bot: @mike_infosec draft looks fine, need to add clause about no redistribution and limit use to procurement evaluation. I'll queue a one-page addendum. ETA tomorrow.

anna_sales: Great — plan for delivery: SOC2 summary + control map (redacted), pen-test attestation (signed), network diagram (redacted), 2 staging SSO accounts + instructions, and a short runbook for the POC test plan. Target delivery: Tue COB. I'll tell the buyer.

raj_solutions: For the network diagram, I'll produce a sanitized Private deployment sketch (remove IPs). Also adding guidance on firewall rules they should simulate.

jess_platform: For the staging inference demo, we need their test prompt set and expected latency targets. Ask them to share a small sample payload (<=1KB) so we can run it through the Dedicated preview.

anna_sales: I'll request the sample payload + expected TPS. Thanks everyone — I'll update the buyer and loop back when we have the legal signature. :thumbsup:
